content: Cromolyn nasal spray is a mast cell stabilizer that has been approved by the FDA for the treatment of nasal symptoms associated with hay fever and nasal allergies. These symptoms include a runny or itchy nose, sneezing, and nasal congestion caused by allergies. Common side effects of this medication include stinging, nosebleeds, and sores inside the nose. Adult Indications and Dosage FDA-Labeled Indications: Cromolyn nasal spray is used to prevent and relieve nasal symptoms of hay fever and other nasal allergies, such as a runny or itchy nose, sneezing, and allergic nasal congestion. Off-Label Use: There is limited information available regarding the off-label use of Cromolyn nasal spray in adults, whether supported by guidelines or not. Pediatric Indications and Dosage FDA-Labeled Indications: There is limited information regarding the FDA-approved use of Cromolyn nasal spray in pediatric patients. Off-Label Use: Similarly, there is limited information about off-label use in pediatric patients, whether supported by guidelines or not. Contraindications There is limited information available regarding contraindications for Cromolyn nasal spray in pediatric patients. Warnings Do not use this medication if you are allergic to any of its ingredients. Consult a doctor before use if you have a fever, discolored nasal discharge, sinus pain, or wheezing. When using this product: It may take several days of consistent use to notice an effect, and the best results may not be seen for 1 to 2 weeks. Brief stinging or sneezing may occur immediately after use. Do not use this medication to treat sinus infections, asthma, or cold symptoms. Do not share the bottle with others to avoid spreading germs. Stop using the medication and consult a doctor if: You experience shortness of breath, wheezing, or chest tightness. You develop hives or swelling of the mouth or throat. Your symptoms worsen, new symptoms appear, or your symptoms do not improve within two weeks. You need to use the medication for more than 12 weeks. If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, consult a healthcare professional before use. Keep this medication out of the reach of children. If swallowed, seek medical help or contact a Poison Control Center immediately (1-800-222-1222).
